coverage: Empty and dollar roots; bare keys; optional root marker; repeated bracket selectors; keys after indices.
Bare escapes consume an entire Unicode scalar, preserve escaped punctuation and whitespace, and do not decode JSON Unicode escapes.
Bracket-quoted JSON strings decode all simple escapes, BMP boundary values, supplementary surrogate pairs, NUL, and empty keys.
Unicode keys match without normalization; quoted and escaped extension punctuation remains literal.
Array index boundaries include zero, 2147483648, and 4294967295; checked accumulation rejects overflowing digits at their original byte offsets.
Leading zeros, signs, negative indices, fractions, exponent notation, non-ASCII digits, and index whitespace are rejected.
Malformed path structure, missing separators, leading dots, bare reserved characters, Unicode whitespace, and forbidden controls are rejected.
Proper truncated prefixes return UnexpectedEof at input end, including incomplete JSON escapes and surrogate continuations.
Wildcards, filters, recursive descent, and index union/slice punctuation return UnsupportedSchemaFeature.
Malformed JSON escapes, invalid hexadecimal digits, lone surrogates, and invalid surrogate pairs verify specific error codes and byte offsets.
Every raw JSON control from U+0000 through U+001F is rejected, while its Unicode escape is accepted.
Multibyte text preceding failures verifies byte offsets rather than scalar counts.
Inclusive and zero textual byte, decoded UTF-8 key byte, segment count, and input-path count limits.
Default 65536-byte text, 4096-byte key, 256-segment, and 4096-input boundaries, plus buffer-growth boundaries.
Synthetic u32 input-length boundary and oversized-length precedence without allocating an oversized string.
parse_many preserves order and duplicates, checks count before parsing, and returns the first error relative to its individual input.
Compilation/query budgets do not restrict basic parsing, and returned paths own their keys independently of input lifetimes.
test_vectors.allocation_failure_paths: All production String and Vec growth uses try_reserve_exact and maps failures to BudgetExhausted. Allocator failures were not injected.
